description:
Run the frozen public `BitMatrix::row_xor` consumer cells and commit the current pre-change evidence.

## Background

This is the primary unhoisted row-operation route. It is measured at actual mid-range row strides with whole-call costs, output validation, and neighboring sizes; already-hoisted algorithm loops remain controls rather than generic-hoist candidates.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A committed receipt contains raw samples, exact commands, frozen matrix inputs, append-only execution log, runtime provenance, statistical summary, and acceptance interpretation for the row-XOR cells.
- [hard] REQ-02: Exact row semantics, canonical bit indexing, and zero tail padding hold for the declared boundary and offset cases.
- [hard] REQ-03: Profiles attribute material time to public dispatch, row access, XOR execution, memory traffic, or downstream work and identify any candidate signal within the frozen search budget.

## Notes

Run only in the benchmark window on the prepared host under the full-host wrapper.
title: Record the row-XOR consumer baseline
